pilot_purpose: Expert-review pilot subset for Clara Yoon (USGS) prior to Stage 4B Part 2B augmentation
pilot_selection_criteria: Geographic dispersion along 450 km Sagaing rupture (north, central, south)
Exact site coordinates verified against reconnaissance documentation
Clear structural shaking evidence distinguished from surface fault offset
Non-redundant with existing USGS DYFI centroids (no co-located double counting)

uncertainty_framework_clarification: Vs30 and NEHRP site classes describe geotechnical site condition properties used for GMPE site amplification. They have no relationship to observational MMI standard deviation (sigma). Model confidence is an uncalibrated heuristic score. No scientifically calibrated sigma for AI estimates has yet been established.

reconciled_baseline_inventory.audit_reference: Reconciliation of ShakeMap 4.5.0 shake_data.hdf and shake_result.hdf for us7000pn9s
reconciled_baseline_inventory.explanation: ShakeMap info.json reports 'intensity_observations: 516' and 'seismic_stations: 5' (521 total), which counts all station entries falling within the regional model bounding box. However, 425 of those 516 DYFI entries had null intensity and were flagged (total_flagged_mi: 425). Only 91 DYFI stations within the model bounds (and 191 globally across the event) possessed valid numeric macroseismic intensity observations that actively constrained the Kriging interpolation.

provenance_policy: StEER Virtual Assessment Structural Team (VAST) reports represent virtual desk studies of secondary media (social media, video, news reports), NOT in-situ ground engineering surveys. Coordinates are site-associated map locations or administrative centroids, not geodetic cadastral surveys. All expert review fields (decision, identity, date, rationale) remain strictly unpopulated pending actual human review.
